widget.name: File Upload Plus
widget.description: Single file or image upload with instant preview, upload states, drag-and-drop, clipboard paste and URL import.

property.caption: Upload type
property.description: Image: bind to a System.Image specialization. File: bind to any System.FileDocument specialization.

property.caption: Image
property.description: The System.Image (specialization) object to upload into, usually the data view object.

property.caption: File
property.description: The System.FileDocument (specialization) object to upload into, usually the data view object.

property.caption: Accepted types
property.description: Comma-separated MIME types or extensions, e.g. image/* or .pdf,.docx. Empty: image/* in Image mode, anything in File mode.

property.caption: Max file size (MB)
property.description: Client-side size limit. 0 means no client-side limit (server limits still apply).

property.caption: Show preview
property.description: Show a thumbnail for images (stored and newly selected).

property.caption: Preview height (px)
property.description: Maximum height of the preview image.

property.caption: Show document preview
property.description: Show PDFs and spreadsheets (.xlsx, .xlsm, .csv), stored or newly selected, in a preview panel below the drop zone.

property.caption: Document preview height (px)
property.description: Starting height of the PDF preview. Users can drag the bottom edge to resize it, minimize it, or expand it to full view.

property.caption: Document preview starts
property.description: Whether the PDF preview starts open or minimized to its header bar.

property.caption: Drop zone text
property.description: Hint shown in the drop zone. Empty uses a default text based on the enabled input methods.

property.caption: Drag and drop
property.description: Allow dropping a file onto the widget.

property.caption: Clipboard paste
property.description: Allow pasting a file or screenshot (Ctrl/Cmd+V) while the widget has focus.

property.caption: Load from URL
property.description: Show a field to load a file from a URL. Only works for URLs that allow cross-origin (CORS) requests. See README.

property.caption: Confirm replace
property.description: Ask for confirmation before replacing an existing file.

property.caption: Replace confirmation text
property.description: Empty uses the default text.

property.caption: Show clear button
property.description: Show a Clear button for a stored file. It runs the On clear action, which must remove the file (e.g. a microflow that deletes the object); the widget API cannot remove stored contents itself.

property.caption: Confirm clear
property.description: Ask for confirmation before clearing.

property.caption: Clear confirmation text
property.description: Empty uses the default text.

property.caption: On file selected
property.description: Runs after a file is chosen. Mendix uploads the file when the page is saved, so set this to Save changes to upload immediately. Leave empty to upload with the page's own Save button.

property.caption: On save click
property.description: Shows a Save button next to Discard while a file is waiting to be uploaded, and runs this action when it is clicked. Use Save changes (or a nanoflow/microflow that starts with Save changes): Mendix uploads the file when the page is saved.

property.caption: Save button caption
property.description: Empty uses "Save".

property.caption: On upload success
property.description: Runs after the file has been stored on the server (e.g. call a microflow/nanoflow or show a page).

property.caption: On upload failure
property.description: Runs when the file is rejected or the save did not store it.

property.caption: On clear
property.description: Runs when the user confirms Clear. Required for the Clear button to appear, e.g. a microflow that deletes the file object or resets it.
